name.zh-Hant: Waveshare Modbus RTU 繼電器（單路）

model: Modbus RTU Relay, Modbus RTU Relay (D) — 8 channels

description.en: One relay channel as a switch: on / off with function 05 (FF00 / 0000), state read back with function 01 every 30 s. The board answers a write with the same frame, which confirms the state. Add one device per channel.
description.zh-Hant: 一路繼電器做成開關：功能碼 05 開（FF00）／關（0000），每 30 秒用功能碼 01 讀回狀態。板子收到寫入會原樣回傳，順便確認狀態。每一路各建一個裝置。

description.en: Modbus address 01–FF (set by command, no DIP switches; examples use 01). Every device on the bus needs its own.
description.zh-Hant: Modbus 位址 01–FF（用指令設定，沒有指撥開關；範例都用 01）。同一條匯流排上每台設備的位址都要不同。

description.en: The channel as a coil address: channel 1 = 00 00 … channel 8 = 00 07.
description.zh-Hant: 這一路的線圈位址：第 1 路＝00 00 … 第 8 路＝00 07。

notes.en: The read answer does not say which coil it is for, so each channel only takes the answer to its own read (reply_to). Flip (5500) is Waveshare's own value and is not idempotent: a retried flip undoes itself, so on / off are used for the switch.
notes.zh-Hant: 讀取的回覆不會寫是哪一路，所以每一路只採用自己那次讀取的回覆（reply_to）。翻轉（5500）是 Waveshare 自訂的值，不是冪等的：重送會再翻回來，所以開關用的是開／關。
